problem_type: Assembly line balancing integer optimization problem with a fixed number of stations: minimize the maximum station idle time subject to unique task assignment, station ranges, immediate precedence relations, and cycle capacity constraints.

decisions.business: Station to which each task is assigned, given by task number.
decisions.shape: list[int], length num_tasks; position i-1 corresponds to task i, and elements are 1-based station numbers.
decisions.completeness: Must contain exactly num_tasks integers; the station of each task must lie within its closed interval [earliest_stations[i-1], latest_stations[i-1]]; every immediate precedence arc must satisfy that the predecessor station is not greater than the successor station; the total processing time of each station must not exceed cycle_time.

decisions.business: Maximum idle time over all fixed stations, which is also the objective value being minimized.
decisions.completeness: Must equal max_{s=1…num_stations}(cycle_time − total task processing time of station s), where all fixed stations take part in the computation; must also not be lower than floor((num_stations × cycle_time − sum(processing_times)) / cycle_time).
